# Exhaust the Design Space

When there is no precedent in the codebase, do not commit to the first shape. Build 2-3 competing prototypes and compare them side by side before choosing. `skill://prototype` sketches one cheaply. `skill://arena` runs several candidates and grafts the best parts.

It also applies to product design decisions where user experience depends on feel, not logic.
